page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines, no margins with text.
page.notes: The title is very faint and much of it appears mirrored, which is show-through from the reverse of the leaf, not printed text on this side. Lines marked above are my best reading and are doubtful throughout; the first line in particular may be read from the reversed impression rather than the printed title. There is a small printer's device or woodcut in the centre of the page, and a faint library stamp at the foot, which are not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
